calls.title: AI Engineer World's Fair Post-Event Debrief
calls.summary: The team debriefed the AI Engineer World's Fair, discussing wins (90+ quality leads, positive swag engagement) and challenges (confusing booth messaging around agentic workflows vs. experimentation, booth positioning, and missed on-site demo scheduling). Key participants included Lyndsie Berens (event organizer), Ashley Stirrup (manager), Liz Fox (marketing), and AEs Daniel Wathne and Christian Liebenow. Next steps: follow up with leads, submit expense
